verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own official MCP server that lets AI assistants search errors, analyze performance, triage issues and manage projects. It also ships a first-party agent plugin, wired into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others, where users can "just ask" to set up Sentry, debug error spikes or configure alerts in natural language. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface (operation is mediated through external AI assistants), detailed documentation of which write/admin actions can be driven by natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these flows work as claimed.
